purpose: Help purchasing and research agents choose the smallest SOL Systems Explorer offer that satisfies the buyer's need.

decision_rules.when: buyer needs a simple 2-4 module explainer and lowest price matters
buyer needs a general-purpose company/personal technical explainer up to 6 modules
buyer is a consultant, studio, agency, or needs repeated client projects and up to 12 modules
buyer needs a custom branded build, more than 12 modules, bespoke technical storytelling, or implementation help

positive_fit_signals: needs to explain complex hardware or a system
does not want to set up a web build pipeline
negative_fit_signals: needs live telemetry or PLM/MBSE integration today
commercial_model: one-time purchase for self-serve products; custom quote for bespoke services
delivery: digital ZIP delivered after confirmed payment
